---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
We have received reports that, following the latest patch, some users’ antivirus software (particularly Windows Defender) is
detecting our game’s executable file (game.exe) as Trojan:Win32/Wacatac.B!ml. After careful investigation, we have
confirmed that this is a false positive and that our game files are safe. We have taken all necessary measures,
including digital signing and file encryption, but occasionally Windows Defender may still flag the file incorrectly.

If you are encountering this issue, we recommend one of the following solutions:

1. Add an Exception in Windows Defender
Open Windows Defender settings and select “Virus & threat protection.”
Under “Protection history,” locate the quarantined file and allow it.
Alternatively, add the game.exe file to the “Exclusions” list.

2. Use a Different Antivirus Program
If you prefer, you can install another reputable antivirus solution.
Temporarily disable Windows Defender to prevent further false detections.

We understand this situation may be frustrating, and we apologize for any inconvenience caused.
Thank you for your patience and continued support.

If you have any additional questions or concerns, please contact our support team.

notes.title: [Info] Update Note for 24th of October
notes.content:
Hello, Savers!

 
On this month's update, we have brought up some measures that will prevent auto-farming/leveling with 3rd party programs.

Over the last decade, we have seen that many of you have been using macro programs, cheat programs, vmware programs, and remote-access programs to play the game automatically, or to play multiple account at the same time. The usage of these programs has harmed every player's fair gameplay. Therefore, we are announcing as of October 18th, 2023, we will be strictly banning the accounts that use any kind of macro, cheat, vmware, and  remote-access programs.

 
Starting on that day, The accounts that have used cheat programs will be banned instantly, and permanently.
For the accounts that have used macro or vmware programs, we have decided to give yout 2 chances. The first usage will result in 1 30-day block, and the second usage will lead to a permanent block.
We ask you to please follow the user agreement that you have agreed on upon account creation, and maintain fair gameplay.

And for the final announcement, we will be holding an amnesty event ending on the last day of October, 2023. If your account was blocked for the usage of a macro-like program, please submit a ticket via SoulSaver website. We will review your accounts  and unblock for the last time. Also, keep in mind that these unblocked accounts will not have 2 chances. If a program is detected again, the accounts will be permanently banned again.

All other accounts that were banned for the reason other than macro-like programs will not be alegible for release. The tickets submitted for these accounts will strictly be ignored.

Starting today, we hope that the players and the staff together can make the game more enjoyable.

 
We have an important announcement to make. We've observed that several users of the Mamluk class have been exploiting a particular game bug. Under normal circumstances, this bug should not manifest. Consequently, we categorize players who exploit this Mamluk bug as violators of our program's terms of use. We urge you to refrain from such actions to avoid potential server restrictions or bans.

Thank you for the love you have given to SoulSaver.

Best Regards,
SoulSaver Team

Official Announcement from Netgame Development Team
 Following an in-depth audit by our SSO development team, we've noted a concerning increase in system misuse by players. Our rigorous monitoring over the past weekend revealed infractions that include:
*Collaboration with cheat-enabled avatars to acquire unauthorized EXP and in-game assets.
*Unauthorized gold transactions on social media platforms.
*Usage of macros for game manipulation.
To maintain the integrity and trustworthiness of our gaming ecosystem, and to protect genuine players from inadvertently acquiring illicit gold, we are updating our management policies.  Commencing August 16th, 2023, any acquisition of gold from external third-party sources will be strictly forbidden.
Furthermore, players detected partaking in dubious trading actions or associating with cheat-enabled accounts will be subject to immediate suspension. We'd like to reiterate that Netgame strictly opposes account sharing or trading. 
Any ramifications from such behavior lie with the account holder.
For the security of your account and to preserve the integrity of our gaming community, we strongly advise against any form of account sharing or trading. Such actions jeopardize the safety and status of your account.
We trust our community members to uphold the standards that make our game a fair and enjoyable experience for everyone. 
Your cooperation and understanding in this matter are highly appreciated.
 Warm regards,

notes.title: [Event] Ghost Shop Bonus Pouch
notes.content:
Dear Savers, 

We will be having a Ghost Shop Bonus Event from 11th April to 25th April!~

How it works: 

Depending on the amount of mCash that you spend in the Ghost Shop each time, you will stand to receive either 1, 2 or 3 bonus pouches:

3000 - 5999 mcash: 1 Bonus Pouch 
6000 - 8999 mcash: 2 Bonus Pouches
9000 & above: 3 Bonus Pouches

Do note that: the reward will be given based on the mCash value of *EACH* purchased item, instead of the cumulative amount of *ALL* your purchased items.

***This means that you have to purchase a single mCash item that costs at least 3000 mCash in order to qualify for this event.

For example:

- Buying 5 Sect Badges will not allow you to qualify for this event, because although the total amount of mCash spent is 6k, each Sect Badge only costs 1.2k mcash, and therefore falls below the minimum required value of 3k.
- However, buying Lucky Slates (which costs 3.5k mCash) will allow you to qualify for this event, and receive 1 Bonus Pouch.
Happy Saving! ~

notes.title: [Solution] How to Solve the Crash Issue
notes.content:
To solve the tutorial flash movie crash issue, 

1) Please go to https://www.adobe.com/support/flashplayer/debug_downloads.html
2) Scroll down until you see "Windows"
3) Click "Download the Flash Player content debugger for Internet Explorer - ActiveX"
4) A flashplayer_25_ax_debug.exe file will be downloaded
5) Run that .exe file & it will prompt you to install Adobe Flash Player. Click "Install", then "Done"
6) Relog into SoulSaverOnline and you can resume the gameplay. ^^
